def _observe_assembly_step_export(core):
    """Observe pure export, protocol and same-run check owners, never native code."""
    capability = "mcad.assembly-step-export/1"
    modules, mismatch = {}, False
    owners = (
        ("engine", None, ("regenerate",)),
        ("part_snapshot", None, ("validate_snapshot_source",)),
        (
            "assembly_service",
            capability,
            ("run_assembly_action", "_run_assembly_action_with_native", "_build_parts"),
        ),
        ("assembly_export", capability, ("run_assembly_step_export",)),
        ("assembly_protocol", capability, ("process_assembly_request",)),
    )
    for name, marker, entrypoints in owners:
        module, foreign = _observe_owned_module(core, name, marker, entrypoints)
        mismatch |= foreign
        if module is not None:
            modules[name] = module
    if len(modules) != len(owners):
        return frozenset(), mismatch
    service, export, protocol = (
        modules["assembly_service"],
        modules["assembly_export"],
        modules["assembly_protocol"],
    )
    linked = (
        getattr(protocol, "run_assembly_step_export", None) is export.run_assembly_step_export
        and getattr(protocol, "run_assembly_action", None) is service.run_assembly_action
        and getattr(export, "_run_assembly_action_with_native", None)
        is service._run_assembly_action_with_native
        and getattr(service, "regenerate", None) is modules["engine"].regenerate
        and getattr(service, "validate_snapshot_source", None)
        is modules["part_snapshot"].validate_snapshot_source
    )
    return (frozenset({capability}) if linked else frozenset()), mismatch

if operation.get("action") == "assembly_export_step":
        export_supported, export_mismatch = _observe_assembly_step_export(core)
        supported.update(export_supported)
        mismatch |= export_mismatch

def export_assembly_step(
        self, assembly_name: str, parts: list | tuple, instances: list | tuple, path: str | Path
    ) -> None:
        """Write one named XCAF assembly using exact local Part definitions.

        Parts contain id/name/shape; instances contain id/name/part_id/frame.
        Frames are already-evaluated rigid world placements, as in transformed().
        References use stable Part IDs, never names or geometric similarity.
        Only the assembly root is transferred: uninstantiated definitions are not
        free solids in the STEP file. Names and reuse are exchange data; canonical
        application IDs, feature history, mates and provenance are not exported.

        The caller owns fresh canonical replay and atomic destination replacement.
        All inputs and solids are checked before this temporary path is written.
        """
        definitions, occurrences, placements = _assembly_step_inputs(
            assembly_name, parts, instances
        )
        for part in definitions.values():
            if not isinstance(part["shape"], TopoDS_Shape):
                raise KernelError("Assembly STEP Part requires an exact native shape")
            self._require_single_solid(part["shape"])

        from OCP.BRepBuilderAPI import BRepBuilderAPI_Copy
        from OCP.STEPCAFControl import STEPCAFControl_Writer
        from OCP.TCollection import TCollection_ExtendedString
        from OCP.TDataStd import TDataStd_Name
        from OCP.TDocStd import TDocStd_Document
        from OCP.XCAFDoc import XCAFDoc_DocumentTool

        try:
            document = TDocStd_Document(TCollection_ExtendedString("BinXCAF"))
            XCAFDoc_DocumentTool.SetLengthUnit_s(document, 0.001)  # Internal mm, in metres.
            shapes = XCAFDoc_DocumentTool.ShapeTool_s(document.Main())
            root = shapes.NewShape()
            TDataStd_Name.Set_s(root, TCollection_ExtendedString(assembly_name, True))
            labels = {}
            original_shapes = []
            for part_id, part in definitions.items():
                shape = part["shape"]
                if any(shape.IsPartner(previous) for previous in original_shapes):
                    # STEP transfer keys by topology, even with explicit XCAF
                    # labels. Distinct Part IDs sharing a replay handle need
                    # distinct topology; retain their exact curves/surfaces.
                    copied = BRepBuilderAPI_Copy(shape, False, False)
                    if not copied.IsDone():
                        raise KernelError("Assembly STEP definition topology copy failed")
                    shape = copied.Shape()
                    if (
                        shape.IsPartner(part["shape"])
                        or not shape.Location().IsEqual(part["shape"].Location())
                        or shape.Orientation() != part["shape"].Orientation()
                    ):
                        raise KernelError("Assembly STEP definition identity copy is invalid")
                    self._require_single_solid(shape)
                original_shapes.append(part["shape"])
                label = shapes.NewShape()
                shapes.SetShape(label, shape)
                TDataStd_Name.Set_s(label, TCollection_ExtendedString(part["name"], True))
                labels[part_id] = label
            for instance_id, instance in occurrences.items():
                transform = gp_Trsf()
                transform.SetValues(*placements[instance_id])
                component = shapes.AddComponent(
                    root, labels[instance["part_id"]], TopLoc_Location(transform)
                )
                if component.IsNull():
                    raise KernelError("Could not create Assembly STEP component")
                TDataStd_Name.Set_s(component, TCollection_ExtendedString(instance["name"], True))
            shapes.UpdateAssemblies()
            writer = STEPCAFControl_Writer()
            writer.SetNameMode(True)
            writer.SetColorMode(False)
            writer.SetLayerMode(False)
            writer.SetPropsMode(False)
            writer.SetCleanDuplicates(False)
            if not writer.Transfer(root, STEPControl_AsIs):
                raise KernelError("Assembly STEP transfer failed")
            if writer.Write(str(path)) != IFSelect_RetDone:
                raise KernelError(f"Could not write Assembly STEP file: {path}")
        except KernelError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            raise KernelError(f"OCCT Assembly STEP export failed: {exc}") from exc

        ("assembly_validation_common", "ACTIONS"),
        ("operation_contracts", "_ASSEMBLY_ACTIONS"),

            node.value
            for node in tree.body
            if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
            and any(
                isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == variable for target in node.targets
            )
        )
        assert (
            ast.unparse(value)
            == "frozenset({'assembly_replay', 'assembly_check', 'assembly_sample'})"
        )

    source_policy = next(
        node

        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "result_version_for"
    )
    expected_policy = ast.parse("""

_require(
    candidate.get("kind") == "assembly"
    and type(candidate.get("assembly_schema_version")) is int

)
selected = 2

        selected = 3
return selected
""")
    assert ast.dump(
        ast.Module(body=source_policy.body[1:], type_ignores=[]), include_attributes=False
    ) == ast.dump(expected_policy, include_attributes=False)
    tree = ast.parse((ADDON / "assembly_export_owner.py").read_text())
    action = [
        node.value
        for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
        and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "ACTION" for target in node.targets)
    ]
    assert len(action) == 1 and ast.literal_eval(action[0]) == "assembly_export_step"
    functions = {node.name: node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)}
    for function, variable, expression in (
        ("_checked_report", "assembly", "assembly_state.read_assembly(state)"),
        ("_checked_report", "version", "assembly_export_bridge.result_version_for(assembly)"),
        ("_historical_projection", "prepared", "snapshot.get('prepared')"),
        (
            "run_export",
            "request",
            "assembly_export_bridge.build_request(snapshot['assembly'], path)",
        ),
    ):
        stores = [
            node
            for node in ast.walk(functions[function])
            if isinstance(node, ast.Name)
            and isinstance(node.ctx, ast.Store)
            and node.id == variable
        ]
        assert len(stores) == 1
        assignments = [
            node
            for node in ast.walk(functions[function])
            if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and node.targets == stores
        ]
        assert len(assignments) == 1 and ast.unparse(assignments[0].value) == expression

def _assembly_step_revision(root):
    assert (root / ASSEMBLY_STEP_FIXTURE).is_file()
    raw = (root / ASSEMBLY_STEP_FIXTURE).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == ASSEMBLY_STEP_SHA256
    revision = json.loads(raw)
    assert set(revision) == {"schema", "base_commit", "added", "changed"}
    assert revision["schema"] == "assembly-step-export-boundary-v1"
    assert revision["base_commit"] == "c40543535d5858455fa2b59941992efe3cb82afd"
    assert set(revision["changed"]) == set(ASSEMBLY_STEP_ORIGINALS)
    assert set(revision["added"]) == ASSEMBLY_STEP_ADDED
    assert not ASSEMBLY_STEP_ADDED & ASSEMBLY_STEP_ORIGINALS.keys()
    return revision


def _assembly_step_bytes(root, name, data=None):
    """Undo only the finite reviewed export delta before every older byte seal."""
    data = (root / name).read_bytes() if data is None else data
    if name not in ASSEMBLY_STEP_ORIGINALS:
        return data
    expected = ASSEMBLY_STEP_ORIGINALS[name]
    if (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == expected:
        return data
    revision = _assembly_step_revision(root)
    if name == "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py":
        label = b"ASSEMBLY_STEP_" + b'SHA256 = "'
        slot = label + ASSEMBLY_STEP_SHA256.encode("ascii") + b'"'
        assert data.count(label) == data.count(slot) == 1
        data = data.replace(slot, label + b"0" * 64 + b'"')
    return _integration_restore_entry(data, revision["changed"][name], expected)


def assembly_step_originals(root):
    """Seal the explicit additions and recover the exact c405435 source/guards."""
    revision = _assembly_step_revision(root)
    for name, entry in revision["added"].items():
        assert set(entry) == {"bytes", "sha256"}
        assert type(entry["bytes"]) is int and entry["bytes"] > 0
        data = (root / name).read_bytes()
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == (entry["bytes"], entry["sha256"])
    return ASSEMBLY_STEP_ADDED, {
        name: _assembly_step_bytes(root, name) for name in ASSEMBLY_STEP_ORIGINALS
    }
